items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: "I think the worst that could happen to you was this Major will ship you down to Texas at his camp, so we could have you down there to play for him, or something like that."

ctx.x: Well, anyway, I said to the recorder, I said, "What do you think they're going to do with me?" He says, "Well, I'll

tell you what I think. I think the worst that could happen to you was this Major will ship you down to Texas at his camp, so we could have you down there to play for him, or something like that." So I said, well, that wouldn't be so bad, you know.

But as it turned out I went back to my regiment and the Colonel -- the Colonel had what everyone called untouchables. I was one of the Colonel's untouchables. When you came to get soldiers, he had a file on this side that was the untouchables, and there was a file on that side which was the touchables. I was one of the untouchables. So the Colonel transferred me to the medics. I became a member of the Medical Corps, which I loved. It was beautiful. I loved that sort of thing, you know. I found I loved it, you…
